definitions.short: Bilhan , the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite
definitions.full: H1092. Bilhan בִּלְהָן proper name, masculine 1. descendant of Esau Gen 36:27 = 1Chr 1:42 . 2 a Benjamite 1Chr 7:10 (twice in verse). בְּלוֺא see below בלה .

occurrences.englishText: These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.
The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
